messages:
amy: quick flag — in api-ref/generate.md the example for the `timeout_ms` param uses milliseconds in the schema but the python snippet says seconds (e.g. 5). that's inconsistent and breaks the docs linter.

jordan: good catch. which snippet file?

amy: under Examples > Request params, the python and js snippets show `timeout: 5` but the openapi and curl examples use `timeout_ms: 5000`.

leo: runtime accepts either `timeout_ms` (int ms) or `timeout` (float seconds) for backwards compatibility, but our docs should pick one canonical form. I'd prefer `timeout_ms` to avoid float parsing differences.

jordan: agree on `timeout_ms`. if we switch examples we should add a short migration note explaining old clients may still send `timeout` in seconds. Also update SDK snippets to use the canonical field.

amy: I'll open a small docs PR to change the python/js/curl examples to `timeout_ms: 5000`, and add the migration note: "Legacy: `timeout` in seconds accepted; prefer `timeout_ms` (integer milliseconds)."

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/672 — CI: failed (example-schema-check).

jordan: that CI failure usually means the openapi schema still expects `timeout` or the example name doesn't match. Did we also update openapi?

amy: not yet — will patch openapi to document `timeout_ms` and keep `timeout` in the description as deprecated.

leo: small caveat: update the python SDK snippet in sdk-snippets repo too — current snippet uses `client.generate(timeout=5)`; change to `client.generate(timeout_ms=5000)`. I'll open that PR.

docs-bot: linked SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-snippets/pull/411 — CI: failing (snippet-presence).

jordan: failing because docs generator expects the exact inline snippet id. amy, include the snippet id in your docs PR so the generator picks up the updated snippet.

amy: done — added snippet id `gen-timeout-example` and updated the codeblocks with language hints. Pushing again.

docs-bot: Docs CI re-run: passing. SDK PR re-run: passing.

leo: merged SDK PR with a unit test asserting `timeout_ms` appears in the generated examples.

amy: merged docs PR. final step: add changelog line: "generate.md: canonicalized timeout param to timeout_ms (milliseconds); added migration note and updated SDK snippets."

jordan: adding changelog now. Also create a brief note for internal release notes so support can triage tickets referencing `timeout` vs `timeout_ms`.

amy: thanks all — closing the loop.
